test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: GBNS is related to EYPV in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, CVRY is related to ASTB. To which of the following is YPVE related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, GBNS is related to EYPV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fad1b07155fa5ff8d40482c9ec76af7b5267ba6acf46185a78b528fcfeac5ad.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f6a4ce8a52e81ccc7d01b84696c958b1a0cb671d39f82a261b574e928c6d980.png] 

For, CVRY is related to ASTB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6ab88b19209c7b2e92b19fa01176acf8fd31dc7ca9358612a733bcbed4b58ca.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e75cc4156d228b05b20d7a1c9b1a3c3d4fe4fdf479c7282b35cbba9d2b07bb3f.png] 

Similarly, for **'YPVE'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2661490ed3d3df0759724d198dd8a64151355691b49c9f6b346096e683052fe.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef929a1e2f4db6d28f4c6980076990499475a7f4f7d5529e93da14f1373b071d.png] 

So, 'YPVE' will be related to **'WMXH'**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
